record.question: Write a Precis of the following passage, giving it a suitable title:
record.direction: PART B — Conventional type, 50 marks. Use the written answer sheet. Printed marks and choices apply.
record.passage: In the modern era, reading culture is undergoing significant shifts due to technological advancements and changing lifestyles. While reading remains vital for personal and academic development, digital platforms, social media, and the constant influx of information are influencing how people engage with reading materials. Creating and maintaining a strong reading culture requires adapting to these changes and promoting reading in both traditional and digital formats. There are a few challenges towards maintaining interest in reading amongst the younger generations. The pervasive nature of smartphones and social media, for example, can make it difficult for people to focus on sustained reading, leading to shorter attention spans and a preference for quick information consumption over in-depth reading. The rise of e-readers, audiobooks, and online articles has changed how people access and engage with reading material, moving away from traditional print formats, such as books. The availability of free or cheaper digital formats contributes to the popularity of digital books over physical books. At the same time, while we may deplore technological advancements and its effects, there are also opportunities to increase readership. The internet provides vast resources for information and knowledge, making it easier for people to access books, articles, and other reading materials. Diverse digital platforms offer a variety of formats, including e-books, audiobooks, and online articles, catering to different reading preferences. Leveraging digital platforms to promote reading, provide access to e-books, and create online reading communities can help reach a wider audience. Technological progress has vastly changed the human landscape, and reading is one such aspect that has changed along with it. While schools, local libraries, NGOs and societies have promoted reading, as society changes, one must adapt accordingly as well. As such, it is of great importance to learn to implement technological advancements to promote reading culture.
